Test a weighted combination with inverse_error weights to see if giving more weight to lower‑error models improves over the mean, given unstable ranking but strong trend dominance.
Test a robust median combination over the full pool to see if it improves over mean given unstable ranking.
The series is trend‑dominated with unstable ranking; a robust DBA over the full pool may outperform mean/median.
Test a softmax‑negative‑error weighted combination on the full pool to see if a non‑linear weighting improves over the linear inverse_error; this probes a different weighting family.
The series is trend‑dominated with unstable ranking; a trimmed‑mean over a smaller, more diverse pool might reduce outlier influence while keeping complementary models.

Test a weighted combination over the small, high‑variance pool1 using softmax‑negative‑error weights to see if a more focused, adaptive weighting improves over mean/median on this trend‑dominated series.
Try a robust weighted combination on a slightly smaller, higher‑ranking pool (pool2) using softmax_neg_error to see if reducing model set and using a variance‑aware weight improves over mean.
Test a weighted combination over the full pool using the w1 weight handle to see if a different weight scheme improves on the mean baseline, given the trend‑dominated, unstable ranking regime.
The series has a strong trend and unstable ranking; a feature‑based weighting might capture model strengths per window.

Test a weighted combination on the small, diverse pool1 using inverse_error weights to see if a stronger, more stable weighting on the top‐performing models improves over the current leader, given the trend‑dominated, unstable ranking context.
Test a robust median combination over the smaller, more diverse pool1 to see if reducing influence of extreme models improves performance given the trend‑dominated, unstable ranking.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted weighted by w1' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.9641. Series context: trend strength 0.9234 and seasonal strength 0.2587; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.092); 2 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 0.333.
